name: Shoham
title: The Levite Who Carried the Ark of the Covenant
summary: Shoham was a Levite from the Gershonite clan, son of Jahath. He was appointed to be responsible for the tabernacle's equipment during the wilderness journey. As a Levite, he played an important role in transporting and guarding the sanctuary.

keyEvents.title: Shoham Mentioned in the Genealogy of the Gershonites
keyEvents.description: Shoham is mentioned as part of the Gershonite clan among the Levites, descendants of Levi.

keyEvents.title: The Service of the Gershonites at the Tabernacle
keyEvents.description: The Gershonites, to whom Shoham belonged, were given responsibility for carrying the tabernacle's curtains, coverings, and hangings during the wilderness journey.

keyEvents.title: The Duties of the Levites under Moses
keyEvents.description: Moses organized the Levites into clans with specific tasks related to the sanctuary, which included Shoham's lineage.

keyEvents.title: The Genealogical Records of the Levites in Chronicles
keyEvents.description: Shoham is recorded in the detailed genealogies of 1 Chronicles, which trace the lineage of the Levites from Levi downward.
